title: When the Cover Sings
author: Jonah Oyelaran
blurb: Noor Nakamura, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must trade the one secret worth killing for before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
